content:
marta: quick async check-in — what I did: finished SOC2 evidence pack for KMS key rotation (logs + runbook), triaged CVE-2025-0421 and CVE-2025-1199 (notes in ticket), merged PR #342 (audit tooling fixes). blockers: need a confirmed low-traffic window for KMS rotation from infra. today: draft rotation schedule, post runbook in #eng-oncall, follow up on PR reviews.

sam: can take lead on the rotation window. I pinged @infra-ops in the infra channel, waiting reply. if they give 2h, we pick 03:00-05:00 UTC on Friday.

alia: CVE quick notes — both findings look like scanner false positives due to old dependency metadata. I attached the package-lock diff in the ticket. steps I ran:
```
npm audit --json > audit.json
cat audit.json | jq '.actions[] | {module, resolution, path}'
```
I also added a mitigation PR with a dependency bump (PR #348).

kevin: ping on code review — can folks review my IAM least-privilege PR #349? it narrows S3 permissions for ingestion service and adds a condition. small manual test instructions in the PR description.

marta: noted, @kevin I can review after rotation plan is posted. Sam — if infra confirms, add the rotation window to the runbook and call out rollback steps. runbook snippet suggestion:
```
- pre-checks: verify key usage metrics < 5% 1h prior
- steps: create new key version -> re-encrypt config -> promote -> observe 15m
- rollback: switch to previous key version and redeploy configs
- post-checks: smoke tests, audit logs collection
```

eng-sec-bot: scanner update: nightly dependency scan found 1 new medium issue in package "xmlparser-legacy" (CVE-2025-0784). Issue filed: https://issues.internal/ENGSEC-821. Assigned to @alia.

alia: taking ENGSEC-821. I’ll check whether patch available or if we need temporary mitigation (monitor + compensate).

sam: infra replied — can do 03:00-05:00 UTC Fri with maintenance page. please document expected 10-15min service degradation window.

kevin: thanks. also, small ask — can we add an automated verification step after rotation to validate that KV cache is using new key? I can add a smoke test script.

marta: yes please add smoke test and put it as a pre/post-check. link it in the runbook when you have it.

sam: created a quick checklist in the ticket and assigned tasks: rotation lead @sam, runbook owner @marta, CVE reviewer @alia, PR reviews @kevin + @marta.

kevin: I pushed a tiny update to PR #349 to clarify the condition doc. no functional changes.

marta: sounds good. blockers resolved if infra window holds. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

eng-sec-bot: reminder: weekly compliance snapshot runs tomorrow at 12:00 UTC — if you updated any evidence today, make sure it’s uploaded by 11:30 UTC.
